scenario_description:
Objective: Make the Lihue market outreach transfer easier while the ordinary baggage-claim-to-curb path and hosted shuttle remain usable.
Emerging Need: A no-fee courtesy cart becomes relevant only after the trip has a fixed arrival, multiple rolling crates, booth code, and posted arrival gate during the same-day signup window.
Decision Context: The useful choice depends on combining the travel notices with stored LIH cart criteria, since the public updates do not explain when a reservation is worth making.
Consequence: Timely use would reduce carrying friction between baggage claim and curb; missing signup loses advance cart certainty; standard self-transfer and shuttle boarding remain, and a walk-up cart can still be requested subject to availability.
